name: ESP32 Firmware Loader
author: Jordan Wiens
description: ESP32-series firmware image loader for Binary Ninja
longdescription: Loads ESP32-series firmware images built with ESP-IDF/PlatformIO. Auto-detects chip variant (ESP32, ESP32-S2, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C2, ESP32-C3, ESP32-C5, ESP32-C6, ESP32-H2, ESP32-P4), creates segments at correct memory addresses, and optionally loads ROM function symbols. RISC-V variants use the built-in rv32gc architecture; Xtensa variants require a third-party architecture plugin.
